mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(pst.pst_id) FROM cdm_own.cmpt_bbs_pst pst INNER JOIN cdm_own.cmpt_bbs bbs ON bbs.bbs_id = pst.bbs_id LEFT OUTER JOIN cdm_own.cmpt_bbs_read_sts sts ON sts.bbs_id = pst.bbs_id AND sts.pst_id = pst.pst_id AND sts.mbr_id = #{memberId} WHERE bbs.bbs_id = 'NOTICE' AND bbs.use_yn = 'Y' AND pst.use_yn = 'Y' AND pst.view_use_yn = 'Y' AND TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') BETWEEN COALESCE(pst.bbs_st_ymd, '19000101') || COALESCE(pst.bbs_st_tm, '000000') AND COALESCE(pst.bbs_ed_ymd, '21991231') || COALESCE(pst.bbs_ed_tm, '000000') AND sts.mbr_id IS NULL

select count(1) as is_entry_answer from cdm_own.cmpt_srvc_qstn csq where csq.cmpy_id = #{cmpyId} and csq.rgtr_id = #{memberId} and csq.srvc_ans_dt is not null and csq.srvc_qstn_rcpt_yn = 'Y' and csq.rgtr_ans_read_dt is null

select count(1) as is_entry_ums from cdm_own.cmpt_ums_sedng_info sndng inner join cdm_own.cmpt_ums_rcvr rcvr on sndng.ums_id = rcvr.ums_id where rcvr.mbr_id = #{memberId} and rcvr.send_rslt_cd = '0000'
